name: damageToPermanent
signature: export function damageToPermanent(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'damage' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 704.5g lethal damage is a state-based action
layerOrTiming: resolution; destruction happens later, in state-based actions
contract: Emits one DAMAGE_CARD per affected permanent and NEVER a MOVE_ZONE: whether marked damage is lethal is CR 704.5g's business, and sba.ts already decides it.
Carries `deathtouch: true` when the source has deathtouch in the LAYERED view, because a granted deathtouch counts and a printed-only read would miss it.
Zero or negative amounts emit nothing.
Does not check indestructible: CR 704.5g does, and duplicating it here would be a second implementation that drifts.
Damage aimed at a PlayerSelector is not this primitive's job and returns an empty result.

evidence.claim: damage is marked on the permanent
evidence.mustContain: permanent.damage(amount.calculate(game, source, this), source.getSourceId(), source, game, false, preventable)

evidence.claim: the effect never destroys anything itself

assertions.expect: one DAMAGE_CARD of 2 and no MOVE_ZONE
still one DAMAGE_CARD and still no MOVE_ZONE - the kill is the SBA's

assertions.given: the DAMAGE_CARD from A2 applied, then state-based actions
assertions.expect: the 2/2 is in the graveyard, destroyed under CR 704.5g

assertions.given: a source with deathtouch granted by a layer effect

assertions.expect: the DAMAGE_CARD is still emitted; nothing here second-guesses 704.5g
